purpose: Define the minimum future ExplainO parameter-space slime trace receipt needed before headless trace runners, seed hunting, stopping-policy work, or GA policy evolution are allowed.

write_seams: ui_app/src/main.cpp live sidecar mutation append path
current_guarantees: ordered target replay from loaded state_json
round-trip preservation through diagnostics/finding state load
malformed legacy history fails atomically during state load
replay count fails fast when greater than loaded history length
known_gaps_for_trace_analysis: no step_index field in each record
no applied_value field distinct from requested target_value

v1_step_record_required_fields.reason: Stable ordered replay and per-step joins across mutation, root, and measurement samples.
Binding path that was selected for mutation.
Mutation value type required for replay validation.
Golden-thread reversal and oscillation/exhaustion analysis need the value before apply.
Requested value selected by the slime/controller policy.
Actual value after binding/clamp/apply must be explicit instead of inferred.
Current sidecar usefulness score is still needed for timeline analysis.
Trace readers need to know why this path/value was selected.
Replay and reversal proof need a stable pre-apply state identity.
Replay and reversal proof need a stable post-apply state identity.
Mutation steps must join to the exact measurement/sample receipt used for scoring.
Root analysis must preserve whether roots are captured runtime authority or fallback.
Root-space analysis needs the runtime roots observed at this step.
Trace bundles must identify the loaded scene/start-state contract.
Deterministic policy replay needs explicit RNG identity, even when no RNG was used.
Policy/genome identity is required before policy comparison or GA work.

compatibility_rules: Legacy sidecar_mutation_history records remain valid ordered replay input.
V1 trace receipts may include a legacy_sidecar_mutation_history projection for compatibility, but state_json.sidecar_mutation_history is not promoted to rigorous trace authority by itself.
Missing v1 required fields must make future trace analysis fail closed instead of silently degrading to legacy history.
Captured runtime roots remain preferred over coefficient-derived roots when both are present.
No future runner may claim golden-thread reversibility without pre_state_hash, post_state_hash, previous_value, and applied_value.
